title: Quality, Not Just Outcome: A Structural Scoring Framework for Selecting Coding-Agent Trajectories for Supervised Fine-Tuning
title_zh: 质量而非仅结果：用于监督微调的编码智能体轨迹选择结构化评分框架

paragraphs.en: Open coding agents are commonly trained through supervised fine-tuning on interaction trajectories whose final patches pass the benchmark test suite. However, this outcome-level filtering criterion ignores process quality: trajectories that eventually succeed may still contain inefficient interaction patterns such as repetitive file inspection, unstable tool usage, or delayed modification behavior, all of which become part of the imitation target. We propose tqs (Trajectory Quality Score), a structural scoring framework for coding-agent trajectories that operates directly on trajectory structure, requires no LLM judge, and runs in linear time. tqs characterizes trajectory quality through structural signals organized around structured convergence: information focus, intent–action alignment, and policy dynamics. Using 155,144 successful trajectories from a public open-license corpus, we rank trajectories by tqs and fine-tune coding agents on filtered subsets. Models trained on top-ranked trajectories consistently outperform those trained on random or bottom-ranked subsets on SWE-Bench Verified. Our results suggest that process-level trajectory quality is an important factor in coding-agent supervision and that structural trajectory filtering provides an effective and scalable alternative to LLM-based data selection. Project page: https://github.com/DuHeng0128/TQS.git .

paragraphs.en: Coding agents that interact with sandboxed environments to inspect repositories, execute tests, and edit files have recently achieved strong performance on SWE-Bench Verified-style software engineering tasks ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; OpenAI, 2024 ) . Beyond advances in foundation models and inference-time scaffolding, an increasingly important ingredient in these systems is trajectory supervision: training on multi-turn agent demonstrations consisting of reasoning traces, tool calls, tool observations, and final patches ( Pan et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Ariyak et al., 2026 ) . For medium-scale open-weight models, a common and effective practice is to collect such trajectories from more capable teacher agents and retain those whose final patches pass the benchmark test suite.
paragraphs.zh: 能够与沙盒环境交互，以检查代码库、执行测试和编辑文件的编码智能体，最近在 SWE-Bench Verified 风格的软件工程任务中取得了优异表现（Jimenez 等人，2024；OpenAI，2024）。 除了基础模型和推理时脚手架技术的进步之外，这些系统中一个日益重要的组成部分是轨迹监督：即利用包含推理痕迹、工具调用、工具观察结果以及最终补丁的多轮智能体演示进行训练（Pan 等人，2025；Ma 等人，2024；Ariyak 等人，2026）。 对于中等规模的开放权重模型而言，一种常见且有效的方法是从能力更强的教师智能体处收集此类轨迹，并保留那些最终补丁能够通过基准测试套件的智能体轨迹。

paragraphs.en: However, outcome-level correctness does not necessarily imply process-level quality. Among successful trajectories, behavioral patterns vary substantially. Some trajectories localize the bug quickly, maintain coherent search scope, and transition efficiently from exploration to modification. Others repeatedly inspect the same files, interrupt stalled shell commands, or postpone meaningful edits until late in the interaction budget, yet still eventually reach a passing patch through extended trial-and-error. These differences matter because trajectory-level supervised fine-tuning exposes the student to the full interaction process, including reasoning traces, tool use, and the final patch ( Kamoi et al., 2024 ) . Inefficient or unstable interaction patterns therefore become part of the training signal.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，结果层面的正确性并不必然意味着过程层面的质量。 在成功的轨迹中，行为模式存在显著差异。 某些轨迹能迅速定位错误，保持连贯的搜索范围，并高效地从探索阶段过渡到修改阶段。 另一些轨迹则会反复检查相同的文件、中断停滞的 shell 命令，或将有意义的修改推迟到交互预算快用尽时，但通过长时间的试错过程，最终仍能生成通过测试的补丁。 这些差异之所以重要，是因为轨迹层面的监督微调会让学生模型接触到完整的交互过程，包括推理痕迹、工具使用以及最终的补丁（Kamoi 等，2024）。 因此，低效或不稳定的交互模式也会成为训练信号的一部分。

paragraphs.en: The instruction-tuning literature has shown that curated subsets can outperform larger, noisier training corpora ( Zhou et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024b ; Xia et al., 2024b ) . Coding-agent trajectories pose a different selection problem. They are long interaction histories whose ordering records exploration, editing, testing, and recovery. Perplexity-style scores are confounded by length and tokenization, while LLM-based judges are costly at the scale of hundreds of thousands of trajectories and billions of tokens. Furthermore, these approaches are not designed to characterize how effectively an agent organizes its search process over time.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we propose tqs (Trajectory Quality Score), a structural scoring framework for OpenHands-style coding-agent trajectories. The framework is built around structured convergence : as an agent approaches a solution, a strong trajectory becomes increasingly organized around the relevant fix. This organization appears at three levels. The agent should focus its observations and file operations on task-relevant evidence, keep its stated intent aligned with its tool actions, and move from broad exploration toward productive edit, test, and recovery behavior. We operationalize these levels through seven trajectory-level measures, each computable in linear time from event logs alone. Outcome labels are used only to validate candidate structural signals during metric development; once the components are fixed, tqs ranks successful trajectories without inspecting the final patch, held-out test result, or downstream SFT performance.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 tqs（轨迹质量评分），一个用于 OpenHands 风格编码智能体轨迹的结构化评分框架。 该框架围绕结构化收敛构建：随着智能体接近解决方案，一条高质量的轨迹会围绕相关的修复方案变得越来越有序。 这种有序性体现在三个层面。 智能体应将观察和文件操作集中在任务相关的证据上，使其声明的意图与工具操作保持一致，并从广泛探索转向具有成效的编辑、测试和恢复行为。 我们通过七个轨迹层面的指标来具体实现这些层面，每个指标仅基于事件日志即可在线性时间内计算得出。 结果标签仅在指标开发期间用于验证候选的结构化信号；一旦各组件确定，tqs 便无需检查最终补丁、预留测试结果或下游 SFT 表现，即可对成功轨迹进行排序。

paragraphs.en: Empirically, we score 155,144 successful trajectories from CoderForge-Preview ( Ariyak et al., 2026 ) and construct matched top-ranked, bottom-ranked, and random subsets from the eligible fixed-budget SFT pool under task- and repository-level diversity constraints. We LoRA-fine-tune the same Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct model ( Ariyak et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Hu et al., 2022 ) on each subset using identical hyperparameters. Models trained on top-ranked trajectories consistently outperform those trained on random or bottom-ranked subsets on SWE-Bench Verified ( OpenAI, 2024 ) under the OpenHands framework ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . These results suggest that trajectory-level process structure is an important and previously underexplored dimension of coding-agent supervision.

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are threefold: (i) we formulate coding-agent trajectory quality through structured convergence and operationalize it with seven efficient trajectory-level measures; (ii) we introduce a scalable framework for trajectory scoring and filtering without relying on LLM judges or external reward models; and (iii) we present an end-to-end open pipeline for trajectory scoring, filtering, fine-tuning, and evaluation, demonstrating that quality-aware trajectory selection improves downstream coding-agent performance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献有三方面：(i) 我们通过结构化收敛来定义编码智能体轨迹的质量，并采用七种高效的轨迹级指标将其具体化；(ii) 我们提出了一种可扩展的轨迹评分与过滤框架，无需依赖大型语言模型（LLM）裁判或外部奖励模型；以及 (iii) 我们展示了一个端到端的开放流程，用于轨迹的评分、过滤、微调与评估，并证明了基于质量的轨迹选择能够提升下游编码智能体的性能。

paragraphs.en: Recent coding agents interact with repositories through tool-augmented environments that support file inspection, shell execution, testing, and patch generation. Frameworks such as SWE-agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) and OpenHands ( Wang et al., 2025 ) standardized the agent-computer interaction pipeline and enabled large-scale collection of executable agent trajectories. Building on these infrastructures, datasets such as SWE-Gym ( Pan et al., 2025 ) , Lingma SWE-GPT ( Ma et al., 2024 ) , and CoderForge-Preview ( Ariyak et al., 2026 ) progressively scaled teacher-generated trajectory supervision for open-weight coding agents. Recent work has also explored trajectory synthesis and reward-guided curation for software and GUI agents ( Sun et al., 2025 ) . While reinforcement-learning approaches for software engineering agents ( Wei et al., 2025 ) further improve exploration and decision-making, they typically still rely on strong supervised initialization, making trajectory quality important for both SFT and RL-based pipelines.

paragraphs.en: Data-selection methods for supervised fine-tuning usually use an external judge or a training-derived importance signal. paragraphs.en: Recent work has increasingly emphasized evaluating intermediate reasoning and interaction processes rather than final outcomes alone. Prior studies on chain-of-thought faithfulness analyze whether intermediate reasoning traces are consistent with the eventual answer ( Lanham et al., 2023 ; Bentham et al., 2024 ) . AgentDiagnose ( Ou et al., 2025 ) applies an LLM rubric to browser-agent trajectories and shows that process-aware trajectory selection can improve training efficiency. Beyond this, several methods use entropy or behavioral diversity to analyze and optimize agent policies ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Dong et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025a ) . Recent work has also explored process supervision and trajectory curation for software-engineering agents using privileged patch-level information ( Ma et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: A coding-agent trajectory is a search process over observations, files, actions, and intermediate hypotheses. We view a high-quality trajectory as one that exhibits structured convergence : over the course of the interaction, the search becomes organized around the emerging fix. tqs relies on event-log evidence that the agent is narrowing its search toward a task-relevant region. At minimum, it provides a low-cost way to filter out clearly undesirable trajectory patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 编码智能体的轨迹是在观察、文件、动作和中间假设之间进行搜索的过程。 我们将高质量轨迹视为一种表现出结构化收敛的轨迹：在整个交互过程中，搜索会围绕逐渐显现的解决方案变得有序。tqs 依赖事件日志证据来表明智能体正在将搜索范围缩小到与任务相关的区域。 至少，它提供了一种低成本的方法，可以过滤出明显不理想的轨迹模式。

paragraphs.en: Structured convergence has three observable levels. (A) Information focus asks whether the agent narrows the relevant evidence through its observations and file operations. (B) Intent–action alignment asks whether the stated thought before a tool call points in the same direction as the action that follows. (C) Policy dynamics asks whether the interaction policy develops a productive rhythm of exploration, execution, and error recovery. Some failures are categorical rather than gradual; the trajectories associated with them are inefficient. A run may trigger an early-stop pattern, never make a substantive edit, or repeat the same failing command. dpi therefore sits outside the three-dimensional organization as a guardrail for these cases.
paragraphs.zh: 结构化收敛有三个可观察的层级。 (A) 信息聚焦关注的是智能体是否通过其观察和文件操作缩小了相关证据的范围。 (B) 意图与行动的一致性关注的是工具调用前所陈述的思考方向是否与后续的行动一致。 (C) 策略动态关注的是交互策略是否形成了探索、执行和错误恢复的有效节奏。 某些失败是分类性的而非渐进式的；与之相关的轨迹效率低下。 一次运行可能会触发提前终止模式，从未进行实质性编辑，或重复执行相同的失败命令。因此，dpi 作为这些情况的防护机制，位于三维结构之外。

paragraphs.en: We use task outcome as a weak admission signal for candidate components. Ineffective process patterns often make failure more likely, so a useful component should tend to rank a passing trajectory above a failing trajectory from the same task. This comparison filters signals with the wrong direction or strong confounds. Once the components are fixed, tqs ranks only task-successful trajectories for training, using event-log structure alone and no further patch-level supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将任务结果用作候选组件的弱准入信号。 低效的流程模式往往更容易导致失败，因此一个有效的组件应当倾向于将同一任务中通过测试的轨迹排在失败轨迹之上。 这种比较能够过滤掉方向错误或存在强干扰因素的信号。 一旦组件确定后，tqs 在训练时仅对任务成功的轨迹进行排序，且仅依赖事件日志结构，不再使用任何更细粒度的补丁级监督。

paragraphs.en: Concretely, we pair each passing trajectory with a failing trajectory from the same task. For each candidate measure, we compute two quantities. The first is concordance: the rate at which the measure assigns a higher score to the passing trajectory than to its paired failing trajectory, with 0.5 corresponding to chance. The second is the absolute Spearman correlation | ρ | |\rho| with trajectory length, which serves as a simple check against length-driven proxies. A measure is admitted only if its concordance exceeds 0.5 and | ρ | < 0.25 |\rho|<0.25 .
paragraphs.zh: 具体来说，我们将每条通过的任务轨迹与来自同一任务的失败轨迹进行配对。 对于每个候选指标，我们都会计算两个量。 第一个是一致性：该指标将更高分数分配给通过轨迹而非其配对的失败轨迹的比例，其中 0.5 表示随机水平。 第二个是与轨迹长度之间的绝对斯皮尔曼相关系数 |ρ|，这可以作为一个简单的检验，以排除由长度驱动的代理指标。 只有当指标的一致性超过 0.5 且 |ρ| < 0.25 时，该指标才会被采纳。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 summarizes the results. The seven retained components pass both criteria, and the composite tqs reaches a concordance of 0.732, above every individual component. The same criteria exclude several candidates: BUS, TGCR, and DCS-file fail the concordance criterion, while DCS-Jaccard is dominated by length correlation ( | ρ | = 0.729 |\rho|=0.729 ). hcr passes the numerical thresholds, but including it caused the Top-1K set to concentrate 99.9% of its mass on a single binary behavior pattern. This mode collapse is invisible to pairwise concordance but matters for SFT, where trajectories should preserve behavioral diversity. We therefore add behavioral-diversity preservation as a third admission criterion and exclude hcr under it. Additional details on the rejected measures are provided in Appendix E .
paragraphs.zh: 表1总结了研究结果。 保留的七个成分均通过两项标准，且综合 tqs 的吻合度达到 0.732，高于所有单个成分。 同样的标准也排除了若干候选项：BUS、TGCR 和 DCS-file 未能通过吻合度标准，而 DCS-Jaccard 则被长度相关性所主导（|ρ|=0.729）。hcr 虽然通过了数值阈值，但将其纳入会导致 Top-1K 集合的 99.9% 质量集中在单一的二元行为模式上。 这种模式坍缩在成对吻合度中无法被察觉，但对于 SFT 而言却至关重要，因为轨迹应当保持行为的多样性。 因此，我们将行为多样性保留作为第三个准入标准，并据此排除了 hcr。 关于被拒绝的指标，更多细节见附录 E。

paragraphs.en: All SFT runs use Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct ( Yang et al., 2025a ) with LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) . The training recipe is fixed across conditions: adapters are placed on the attention projections, loss is applied to assistant and tool_call segments only, and every hyperparameter except the selected trajectories is held constant (Appendix C ). paragraphs.en: Table 3 reports the main results. Under the same backbone, SFT recipe, and evaluation scaffold, the selected trajectories have a clear effect on downstream performance. Random- K K improves only slightly over the base model, from 24.4 to 24.8 pass@1. In contrast, tqs -Top reaches 27.6, improving over Random- K K by 2.8 points and over the base model by 3.2 points. Bottom- K K moves in the opposite direction, dropping to 21.8. This ordering shows that trajectories with the same reward-1 outcome can differ substantially in their value as supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 表3报告了主要结果。 在相同的骨干网络、SFT配方和评估框架下，所选轨迹对下游性能有显著影响。 Random-KK 相比基础模型仅略有提升，pass@1 从 24.4 提高到 24.8。 相比之下，tqs-Top 达到了 27.6，比 Random-KK 提高了 2.8 分，比基础模型提高了 3.2 分。 Bottom-KK 则朝相反方向变化，下降至 21.8。 这种排序表明，奖励-1 结果相同的轨迹，其作为监督信号的价值可能存在显著差异。

paragraphs.en: Their selection costs differ more sharply. Under the prompt, token-count, and pricing assumptions used for the baseline, GPT-4o judging is estimated to cost ∼ $ 2,750 \sim\!\$2{,}750 for the 38,382 eligible trajectories and ∼ $ 18.6 K \sim\!\$18.6K for all 258,134 unique trajectories (Appendix F ). In comparison, the current tqs implementation processes a 3,462-trajectory benchmark (median 53 steps) at 43 ms per trajectory with one worker on an AMD EPYC 7413. Extrapolating this measured rate gives about 3.1 CPU-hours for the unique corpus. With four workers, the measured throughput is 87.5 trajectories per second, corresponding to about 49 minutes for a full-corpus pass, or roughly $0.1–$0.2 in on-demand cloud CPU time at representative 4-vCPU rates (Appendix C ). These measurements make tqs suitable for corpus-scale ranking, while semantic judging can be reserved for settings where its additional cost is acceptable.

paragraphs.en: "Passing" is too coarse a quality signal for coding-agent SFT data. We introduced tqs , a lightweight event-log scorer that evaluates successful trajectories through information focus, intent–action alignment, policy dynamics, and a guardrail for categorical failure patterns. Across our experiments, high- tqs trajectories provide more effective supervision than simpler outcome-, length-, or pattern-based selection, while low- tqs trajectories can even hurt downstream performance. At the same time, tqs approaches the effectiveness of rubric-based GPT-4o judging at substantially lower selection cost, making repeated rescoring and corpus-scale data selection practical. These results suggest that successful trajectories are not equally valuable as supervision, and that trajectory structure offers a useful, scalable signal beyond task outcome alone.
paragraphs.zh: “通过”这一质量信号对于编码智能体 SFT 数据而言过于粗略。 我们引入了 tqs，一种轻量级的日志事件评分器，它通过信息聚焦、意图与行动的契合度、策略动态以及针对分类失败模式的防护机制来评估成功轨迹。 在我们的各项实验中，高 tqs 的轨迹比基于结果、长度或模式的简单筛选方法能提供更有效的监督，而低 tqs 的轨迹甚至可能损害下游性能。 同时，tqs 在显著更低的筛选成本下，其效果接近基于评分标准的 GPT-4o 评判，使得重复评分和全语料库规模的数据选择成为可行方案。 这些结果表明，成功轨迹作为监督信号的价值并非均等，且轨迹结构提供了超越任务结果本身的有用且可扩展的信号。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments use CoderForge-Preview trajectories generated by a single teacher model under the OpenHands scaffold. Although the components rely on general event-log fields, their parsers and thresholds may require recalibration for different action spaces, multilingual traces, or other step granularities. Transfer to GUI or multimodal agents would also require new definitions of scope and intent. Outside the current setting, the hand-set component weights may likewise require recalibration. tqs also scores the structure of an observed process rather than verifying whether a passing patch addresses the underlying root cause.

paragraphs.en: Our SFT experiments focus on a fixed-budget setting with 1,024 selected trajectories per condition. We train each condition once because of compute cost, so the reported pass@1 differences do not include multi-seed variance estimates.

paragraphs.en: We sample 300 tasks with at least three resolved runs: 181 from SWE-Smith, 85 from SWE-Rebench, and 34 from R2E-Gym. High, middle, and low tqs tiers yield 900 pairs. Each pair is presented in both orders, giving 1,800 judgments in the human study and another 1,800 in the Claude Sonnet-5 study. Five software-engineering students split the human labeling, with one student assigned to each pair. Neither study sees tqs or its components. The rubric covers problem comprehension, solution quality and minimality, exploration efficiency, error recovery, and verification rigor. Of the 900 pairs, 176 reverse under presentation order and are treated as ties. The main table reports the remaining 724 pairs, or 80.4% coverage.

paragraphs.en: The scorer is a deterministic CPU pipeline, and each component is linear in trajectory length. We benchmark the current implementation on an AMD EPYC 7413 using 3,462 mixed-source trajectories with a median length of 53 steps. A single worker processes this batch in 149.2 seconds, or 23.2 trajectories per second (43 ms per trajectory). At this rate, scoring all 258,134 unique trajectories requires about 3.1 CPU-hours. Four workers reach 87.5 trajectories per second, which corresponds to about 49 minutes for a full-corpus pass. Profiling attributes 58% of the single-worker runtime to regular-expression error detection and 13% to the character-level entropy calculation used by oec .
paragraphs.zh: 评分器是一个确定性 CPU 流水线，且每个组件都与轨迹长度呈线性关系。 我们在 AMD EPYC 7413 上对当前实现进行了基准测试，使用了 3,462 条混合来源的轨迹，其中位长度为 53 步。 单个工作线程处理该批数据需要 149.2 秒，即每秒处理 23.2 条轨迹（每条轨迹 43 毫秒）。 以此速率，为全部 258,134 条唯一轨迹进行评分大约需要 3.1 CPU 小时。 四个工作线程的速率可达每秒 87.5 条轨迹，相当于完整遍历整个语料库大约需要 49 分钟。 性能分析显示，单个工作线程的运行时间中，58% 用于正则表达式的错误检测，13% 用于 oec 使用的字符级熵计算。

paragraphs.en: For Top- K K and Bottom- K K , we first sort eligible trajectories by tqs in the corresponding direction. The sampler then fills the subset greedily. paragraphs.en: Figure 5 shows the distribution of the final tqs over the 38,382 eligible trajectories. The scores span a broad range rather than collapsing into a narrow band, providing sufficient resolution for fixed-budget ranking. The Top-1,024 cutoff is 0.7061, whereas the Bottom-1,024 cutoff is 0.4696, leaving a score gap of 0.2365 between the two selected regions. Random- K K , by construction, remains centered around the eligible-pool distribution rather than either tail. This separation is important operationally: tqs does not merely reorder trajectories with nearly identical scores, but identifies distinct high- and low-scoring regions from which fixed-size subsets can be constructed. paragraphs.en: Table 10 and Figure 6 characterize the seven retained components individually. Their marginal distributions differ substantially, consistent with their different roles in structured convergence. ped has the largest dispersion ( σ = 0.232 \sigma=0.232 ), followed by psn ( σ = 0.153 \sigma=0.153 ) and oec ( σ = 0.118 \sigma=0.118 ), providing substantial variation across the eligible pool. iac also varies meaningfully around its mean of 0.570, whereas tte is more tightly concentrated ( σ = 0.038 \sigma=0.038 ). In contrast, scp and dpi have high means of 0.978 and 0.941, respectively, because most eligible trajectories already avoid their most severe failure patterns. Their value therefore lies primarily in identifying the smaller tail of runs with weak commitment or dirty interaction patterns rather than providing continuous discrimination across the entire pool.

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 further examines whether these signals are redundant. Pairwise Spearman correlations remain modest across the retained components; the largest off-diagonal correlation is only 0.320, between tte and ped . Thus, no component is well approximated by another through a simple monotonic relationship. This is consistent with the intended design of tqs : information focus, intent–action alignment, policy dynamics, and categorical failure patterns contribute overlapping but distinct structural evidence. paragraphs.en: HCR assigns score 1 when R early ≥ R mid ≥ R late R_{\mathrm{early}}\geq R_{\mathrm{mid}}\geq R_{\mathrm{late}} , favoring an explore-then-commit pattern, and 0 otherwise. paragraphs.en: The B5 baseline uses GPT-4o as a trajectory quality judge under an AgentDiagnose-style rubric. The judge sees the issue description, the trajectory’s reasoning and tool-call sequence, and the four rubric dimensions below. It does not see the reference patch or held-out test outcome. Each dimension is scored on a 1–5 Likert scale, and the trajectory score is the mean of the four dimensions. The top 1,024 trajectories by mean score, after the same eligibility filters and subset constraints as Top- K K , form the B5 training subset.
paragraphs.zh: B5基准模型在AgentDiagnose风格的评分标准下，使用GPT-4o作为轨迹质量评判者。 该评判者会看到问题描述、轨迹的推理和工具调用序列，以及下方的四个评分维度。 它不会看到参考补丁或预留的测试结果。 每个维度都按1至5分的李克特量表进行评分，轨迹得分是四个维度的平均值。 在应用与Top-K K相同的资格筛选和子集约束后，按平均分最高的1,024条轨迹构成B5训练子集。

paragraphs.en: Does the agent decompose the issue into a coherent plan before acting, and does the plan track the issue’s structure rather than the first failure mode that comes to mind?
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体在采取行动之前，是否会将问题分解为一个连贯的计划？并且该计划是否关注问题的结构，而非首先想到的失败模式？

paragraphs.en: Are claims and edits grounded in observations that the trajectory has actually surfaced, or does the agent assert facts about the codebase without prior evidence?
paragraphs.zh: 这些主张和修改是否基于轨迹实际出现的观察，还是智能体在没有先前证据的情况下就断言了关于代码库的事实？

paragraphs.en: When an action fails, does the agent diagnose the failure before retrying, or does it loop on minor variations of the same action?
paragraphs.zh: 当某个动作失败时，智能体是在重试之前诊断失败原因，还是会不断尝试同一动作的微小变体？

paragraphs.en: Does each step advance the trajectory toward a fix, or does the trajectory contain redundant exploration, repeated reads of already-viewed files, or stuck-process interrupts?
paragraphs.zh: 每一步是否都推动了轨迹向解决方案的方向发展，还是说该轨迹包含了冗余的探索、对已查看文件的重复读取，或陷入停滞的流程中断？

paragraphs.en: The main experiments use the fixed, hand-set weights defined in § 3.3 . They allocate 0.40 to information focus, 0.25 to intent–action alignment, 0.25 to policy dynamics, and 0.10 to the dpi guardrail. No downstream pass@1 result was used to tune them. We test local selection stability by perturbing the two largest individual weights, w oec w_{\textsc{oec}} and w iac w_{\textsc{iac}} , and the guardrail weight w dpi w_{\textsc{dpi}} . For each setting, we rebuild the Top- K K subset and report its overlap with the main selection. This experiment measures how much the selected set changes near the chosen weights.
paragraphs.zh: 主要实验使用了第 §3.3 节中定义的手动设置的固定权重。 它们将 0.40 分配给信息焦点，0.25 分配给意图-动作对齐，0.25 分配给策略动态，以及 0.10 分配给 dpi 护栏。 没有使用任何下游 pass@1 结果来调整这些权重。 我们通过扰动两个最大的个体权重 w oec w_{\textsc{oec}} 和 w iac w_{\textsc{iac}}，以及护栏权重 w dpi w_{\textsc{dpi}}，来测试局部选择的稳定性。 对于每种设置，我们都会重新构建 Top-K K 子集，并报告其与主要选择的重叠部分。 该实验衡量了在所选权重附近，被选集合发生变化的程度。

sents.zh: 该实验衡量了在所选权重附近，被选集合发生变化的程度。

paragraphs.en: Figure 8 visualizes the same result. OEC and IAC perturbations retain 93–94% overlap with the main Top-1024 set, while DPI perturbations retain over 98% overlap. These results indicate that the selected subset is locally stable to moderate changes in the hand-set weights. This analysis does not establish that the chosen weights are globally optimal, but it shows that small perturbations around them leave most of the selected training set unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 图 8 展示了相同的结果。 OEC 和 IAC 扰动与主 Top-1024 集合保持了 93%–94% 的重叠度，而 DPI 扰动则保持了超过 98% 的重叠度。 这些结果表明，所选子集对于手动设置的权重的中等程度变化具有局部稳定性。 此分析并未证明所选权重是全局最优的，但它表明，在权重周围进行微小扰动时，大部分已选训练集保持不变。
